verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Ascribe unto the Lord
The glory due His name
Ascribe unto the Lord
The honor and the praise

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
For He is holy
And He is worthy of
All of the glory
And all of our love

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Great and marvelous are Your works, O Lord
Just and true are all of Your ways in all the earth
Alpha, Omega, the Beginning and the End
Forever we'll praise the name of the Lord Most High
